templates.text: A sudden whiff of strong perfume → head turns sharply away, a brief, sharp cry erupts.
The scent of milk formula wafts near → rooting reflex initiates, lips purse and smack.
Acrid odor of antiseptic → body stiffens momentarily, followed by a soft, grunting exhale.
Faint trace of mother's skin scent → quieting, subtle nuzzling motion against the crib sheet.
Overpowering smell of alcohol swab → face scrunches, a single, high-pitched vocalization.
Earthy aroma of clean linen → breathing deepens and slows, hands relax from fists.
Pungent scent of a soiled diaper → legs draw up in a startle-like motion, a fussy whimper.
Sweet, floral note from a lotion → eyes flutter open briefly, a contented sigh follows.
Sharp, metallic hospital smell → a brief apnea, then a rapid series of shallow breaths.
Warm, familiar scent of breast milk → active searching with mouth, hands move toward face.
Stale, recycled air from a vent → a slight shudder, then a muted, grumpy coo.
Sour note of spit-up on clothing → head turns to the side, tongue extends in a slight gag.
Fresh, green scent of baby soap → muscles relax visibly, a soft 'ah' sound is released.
Burnt smell from a distant heater → a full-body startle, a sharp cry lasting {seconds} seconds.
Mild, powdery scent of talc → sucking motions begin spontaneously, eyes remain closed.
Rancid odor of old food → grimace deepens, a series of distressed, hiccup-like cries.
Clean, ozone smell after rain (through a window) → breathing pattern becomes more regular and even.
Overly sweet, synthetic fruit scent → a confused pause, then a brief, questioning whine.
Musky scent of a unfamiliar caregiver → slight withdrawal, arms cross in a self-soothing gesture.
Sharp vinegar aroma → nostrils flare, a quick, reflexive sneeze clears the airway.
Faint smell of leather from a bag → eyes open wide for a moment, gaze becomes unfocused.
Warm, yeasty smell of bread (distant) → mouth opens in an 'O', gentle sucking sounds follow.
Chemical smell of new plastic toy → face turns away, a low-grade, continuous fuss begins.
Eucalyptus or mild menthol in the air → nasal flaring, a deeper, clearer inhalation occurs.
Sulfurous note of a hard-boiled egg → gag reflex triggers mildly, followed by a cough.
Vanilla or other comforting bakery scent → a faint smile reflex appears, limbs extend gently.
Stale tobacco smoke on clothing → agitation increases, cry becomes harsh and grating.
Salty, oceanic air (if near coast) → movements calm, a soft, rhythmic cooing starts.
Pungent aroma of strong cheese → a pronounced frown, head shakes side-to-side once.
Clean, sun-dried cotton scent → the Moro reflex is inhibited, settling occurs more quickly.
